review_question: Among adults, is longitudinal variability in body weight or BMI associated with subsequent cardiovascular morbidity or cardiovascular mortality?

intervention_or_exposure.description: Longitudinal variability or fluctuation in body weight or body mass index

comparator.description: Lower weight or BMI variability, or a per-unit increase in variability

outcome.description: Any source-defined incident cardiovascular morbidity or cardiovascular mortality outcome

targets.comparison: Any directly reported body-weight or BMI variability comparison or continuous exposure scale, preserving its source-defined reference
targets.population_or_subgroup: Every source-reported eligible analytic population or subgroup; do not select among them during extraction

timepoint_policy.rule: Preserve every source-reported eligible follow-up or time window; do not select a final timepoint during extraction

extraction_notes: Do not treat baseline characteristics or concurrent cross-sectional associations as longitudinal outcomes.
Retain every directly reported eligible model, subgroup, contrast, and follow-up as a separate source candidate.
Do not decide which candidate is most adjusted, longest, independent, poolable, or part of a final analysis.

human_escalation_rules: The source reports an effect but its estimand, reference group, model, subgroup, or timepoint is ambiguous: preserve the candidate and flag the ambiguity rather than selecting or discarding it.
